name: a CONFLICT on verified facts stays out of the envelope
a CONFLICT on unverified facts is a problem
a CONFLICT is said to rest on nothing unverified
find: rests_on = sorted(name for name in used if not facts[name].get("verified"))

name: a pick's notes leave the envelope
the envelope drops notes and assumptions
find: said.update({key: list(value) for key, value in (("notes", notes), ("assumptions", assumptions)) if value is not None})

name: a fix is never printed under the lines
an item the lines already say is said again
next steps never reach the text
find: lines += ["  next: %s — %s" % (" ".join(step["argv"]), step["why"]) for step in answer.next]

name: the files --keep wrote leave the JSON
find: said.update({"wrote": [{"file": k["file"], "did": k["did"]} for k in kept]} if kept is not None else {})
